name: RoboMaster Referee System Small Armor Module AM03 (CAD is the AM02 small armor)

files.note: Single multi-body part, 16 bodies ('001'..'016'); has per-face colours (light blue-grey 0.79/0.82/0.93 and 0.90/0.92/0.93 - SolidWorks defaults, not real colours).

download_url_alt: https://rm-static.djicdn.com/tem/17348/RoboMaster Referee System Armor Modules AM02.STEP (same byte size, 5476473)
license: No explicit license on the file. Published publicly by DJI/RoboMaster as a free download for teams' robot design; DJI manuals state the products/manuals are (c) DJI, all rights reserved, no modification/redistribution without permission. Treat as reference geometry: rendering a stylized model is a judgment call; do not redistribute the raw STEP.
mass_note: 359 g is the AM02 figure; no separate AM03 spec published.
colors: Matte black impact panel inside a black frame with 4 corner screws; two translucent white light strips on the left/right edges that glow solid red or blue (team colour), flash on hits.
notes: DOUBT: DJI has not published an AM03-specific CAD, spec or photo. AM03 is real: the Referee System User Manual V1.4 (2025) and V1.5 (2026) list 'Small Armor Module (AM02/AM03)' and 'Large Armor Module (AM12/AM13)' under one shared illustration, i.e. a revision with the same outline. The official small-armor page (wiki 811816) still offers only the AM02 STEP. The RMU 2027 spec manual (2026-10-15) says the 2027-season armor impact surface becomes a dot-matrix screen - a different future module, not modelled by this file. Third-party mirror checked: github.com/jiushipanta/armor_module (MIT) has only AM02/AM12 STEP.
